# T47 Group

> T47 Group is a Phoenix, Arizona holding company founded by Nino Mihilli. It builds, operates and invests in companies across technology, staffing and consumer products, and shares design, engineering and operating support across its portfolio.

- Founder: Nino Mihilli (https://www.ninomihilli.com)
- Location: 4015 N 15th Ave, Phoenix, AZ 85015
- Email: info@t47group.com
- Phone: 602-899-4006

## Portfolio

- [Xsatori Labs](https://xsatorilabs.net): Phoenix software studio that builds apps, marketplaces, blockchain products and internal business software, for a fee or as a selective cash-and-equity venture partner. Also shown at https://t47group.com/xlabs/
- [Hookah Royale](https://hookahroyale.com): Social card-game lounge (Kon Khan, 31, Texas Hold'em, Blackjack) for web and mobile.
- [Xsatori](https://xsatori.com): Sports-investing marketplace for trading positions on games and athletes.
- [FLAT Staffing](https://www.flatstaffing.com): Front Line All Temps, a Phoenix staffing company for warehouse, automotive, auto auction and general labor work.
- [Nino Mihilli](https://www.ninomihilli.com): Founder's personal site on entrepreneurship and faith-driven leadership.
